chunks: In whatever matter you disagree the ultimate judgement rests with God. This is God, my Lord; in Him have I placed my trust, if to Him I turn.
ai.seo_question: Who has the final judgment in matters of disagreement according to the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse establishes the ultimate jurisdiction of God over all disputes, often interpreted as referring to the infallible Imams who serve as His representatives on earth. The concluding declaration of trust (tawakkul) and return (tawbah) underscores the believer's spiritual orientation toward divine sovereignty amidst worldly disagreements.
